title: Florida Elections
text:
This page examines results from the 2026 Florida primary election using precinct-level data from the Florida Department of State Division of Elections.









The chart above displays the total statewide votes cast in the 2026 Florida U.S. Senate primary election by candidate and political party.

title: Minnesota Elections
text:
This page examines results from the November 3, 2026 Minnesota general election using precinct-level data from the Minnesota Secretary of State.









The chart above displays statewide vote totals in the 2026 Minnesota U.S. Senate general election across all candidates and parties (note that Minnesota’s Democratic affiliate is the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party, DFL).

title: Elections
text:
This project examines results from the November 3, 2026 North Carolina general election using official precinct-level data provided by the North Carolina State Board of Elections.









The chart above displays the total statewide votes cast in the 2026 U.S. Senate race, comparing results across all participating candidates and parties. In the interactive map below, hover over any precinct to see the percentage to which each party won.
